posts.author: Sam Dykstra
posts.text: This Brewers-Rays World Series is going to rule. Tell your friends.
posts.jp: このブルワーズ対レイズのワールドシリーズ、絶対に面白くなる。みんなに教えてあげて。

posts.author: Adam McCalvy
posts.text: There's a woodpecker and a mother, missed. A newborn, undaunted. A father, remembered. Strangers, bonded. And lots of screaming and tears. We asked fans to share stories of the Brewers' pennant-clincher, and you all came through in a big way. www.mlb.com/news/brewers...
posts.jp: キツツキがいて、会えなかった母がいて。生まれたばかりの赤ちゃんは物怖じせず。思い出された父がいて。見知らぬ人同士が結ばれて。そして大絶叫と涙。ブルワーズのリーグ優勝決定の瞬間についてファンの皆さんに体験談を募ったところ、たくさんの素晴らしい声が届きました。

posts.author: Andy Kostka
posts.text: Not that anyone really cares, but this will make for a fun algorithmic test when people search for "Orioles Banner" and "Baltimore Banner" and things like that. I now have a good excuse if my numbers tank
posts.jp: 誰も気にしないだろうけど、「オリオールズ Banner」や「Baltimore Banner」などで検索されたとき、アルゴリズムの面白いテストになりそう。数字が落ちても、これでいい言い訳ができた。

posts.text: The Guardians had first and second with nobody out. Three pitches later, the inning ended with zero runs scored.

reply_texts.text: Great season Guards. Didn’t expect this much. Happy with it.
